## Bugs Fixed

### BUG-001 — Missing Item Existence Check (KeyError)
- **Location:** `app.py`, `place_order()`, line ~35
- **Symptom:** Requesting a non-existent item raised an unhandled `KeyError`, returning HTTP 500
- **Fix Applied:** Added `if order.item not in inventory: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, ...)`
- **Test:** `test_order_unknown_item_returns_404` — now PASSES

### BUG-002 — Negative Quantity Not Validated
- **Location:** `app.py`, `Order` Pydantic model, `quantity: int`
- **Symptom:** Negative quantities were silently accepted, increasing inventory (a stock manipulation vulnerability)
- **Fix Applied:** Changed to `quantity: int = Field(..., gt=0)` using Pydantic validation
- **Test:** `test_order_negative_quantity_rejected` — now PASSES

### BUG-003 & BUG-004 — Wrong HTTP Status Code for Out-of-Stock
- **Location:** `app.py`, `place_order()`, stock check
- **Symptom:** Business logic failure (out of stock) raised HTTP 500 (Server Error) instead of HTTP 400 (Bad Request)
- **Fix Applied:** Changed `status_code=500` to `status_code=400` with descriptive error detail
- **Test:** `test_order_out_of_stock_returns_400` — now PASSES
